core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Maulana corresponds to the Arabic form مولانا (Arabic مَوْلَانَا (Mawlānā), from مَوْلَى (mawlā)). Its core sense is master, lord, patron. Maulana is Arabic مَوْلَانَا (Mawlānā) 'our master, our lord', a title formed from مَوْلَى (mawlā) with the first-person plural possessive. The source gloss 'Master, Owner' is broadly consistent. Recorded as a title rather than a personal name. Same name as mawlana.

faq.a: In Urdu, Maulana is rendered مولانا and carries the sense مولا، مالک، سرپرست.

faq.q: What does Maulana mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Maulana is rendered مولانا and carries the sense مولا، سرور، صاحب.
A romanized syllable approximation is mau-la-na. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Maulana?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Maulana, maulana. Script forms are مولانا, मौलाना.

faq.q: Is Maulana a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
